history.sg_progress: The Operation notes that the unique challenges that contributed to the scenario reported by the Board include: complex processes for the clearance of imports; restrictions and detentions by the host country; drastic changes to the Operation’s mandate, that led to a significant reduction in the Operation’s footprint; an average distance of over 2,000 km from the seaport to the Operation area; and uncertainty over the Operation’s lifespan. Details of all the challenges faced will be included in the end-of-mission report, as recommended.

history.administration_response: To the extent possible, the requested details were included in the UNAMID End of Mission DMS Drawdown report dated 25 July 2021.
